study.question: Conditional on the unchanged official_offline history/task masks, does the observed-action advantage depend on action-aware scoring, direct action values/summaries, or their interaction, and which of these dependencies changes with task-index versus shared residual-bank readout?
study.hypothesis: The existing token deletion jointly removes actions from scorer inputs and prediction values, so it cannot locate their utility. In the one-seed records, full-minus-zero click AUC is 0.0255635402 with task routing and 0.0242851488 with shared routing; the difference-in-differences is 0.0012783914. The brand-code replacement recovers only 0.0002396797 over zero/task. These are provisional conditional information effects, not repeated support. Working hypothesis: direct values/summaries recover more of the advantage than the scorer alone, with a positive scorer contribution when direct values are present; the scorer/value interaction may itself depend on residual routing. Null, reversed and redundant-path outcomes are informative. No claim of a novel architecture or production causality.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local parent source SHA256 63ce570394d1645fffa5950198fbdd6c9a86ef9ac0376c5fc121e12690ab69f6 inspected. It always sends actions to both the DIN scorer and direct values/summaries. This proposal changes only availability of those two paths, crossing the inherited task/shared residual readout. It adds no learned architecture.

Prior token factorial inspected, with observed/shared, zero/shared and brand replacement siblings. Those cells jointly change scorer and direct-value content. Four new mixed-path cells complete S x V x R using the existing S=V endpoints, subject to host bridge parity. Previous shared routing averages the entire four-adapter bank; it is not a complete task-independent model.

Archived exact-version primary text arXiv:1706.06978v4, section 4.3 lines 250-277 read; target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and weighted value pooling are inherited. Separating action availability between these paths is a local attribution intervention, not a claim of priority over DIN or attention.

study.proposed_difference: Add independent architecture booleans action_in_scorer=S and action_in_values=V. Compress the observed stream once with the original masked assignments. In _interactions set only its action coordinates to exact zero when S=False, for both primary and auxiliary scorer calls. For V=False use one parameter-free channel projection that keeps all item coordinates and zeros only action coordinates before every direct pool and before all five summary contractions. Summaries, pooled values and base features can still encode action indirectly through S-dependent weights. Conversely V can affect residual correction but not the DIN scorer input. Four standalone sources implement (S,V)=(1,0),(0,1), each at task/shared routing; full (1,1) and zero (0,0) are existing controls. Current target action is never used. This identifies incremental conditional paths under retraining, not the percentage of the entire joint-over-DIN gain explained by feedback: DIN also uses actions and a DIN no-action control is unavailable. For the diagnostic S=V=0 bridge, erase action IDs before embedding and replace the resulting action embedding by exact zeros, retaining the prior disconnected action-parameter graph as well as zero forward values; this branch is inactive in all four submitted mixed cells.
predictions: Preflight: all new sources have identical learned parameters, shapes, initialization and inherited buffer structure; expected stored counts are 32129765 total, 31793216 embedding and 336549 dense, pending host verification. Masked-event item/action perturbations must not change predictions or persistent buffers; target action perturbation must have no effect.

Preflight bridges at common state: S=V=1 matches g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached/task and g1-r0024-token_observed_shared/shared. S=V=0 matches g1-r0024-token_zero_task/task or g1-r0024-token_zero_shared/shared in finite outputs, Dice updates, dense/item/action gradients and one-step updates within declared numerical tolerance. Do not assume local scalar/AST checks prove tensor parity.

Define A_sv,r as frozen-protocol click AUC. At each routing report scorer increments A10-A00 and A11-A01; value increments A01-A00 and A11-A10; interaction I_r=A11-A10-A01+A00. Also report each increment difference between task and shared and I_task-I_shared. AUC is nonlinear; these are predictive-scale contrasts, not additive causal mediation fractions.

Directional prediction: A01-A00 exceeds A10-A00 at task routing, and A11-A01 is positive. Reverse ordering falsifies the proposed dominance; a useful score-only result would support a distinct admissible route. A positive I_r would indicate complementarity on the AUC scale; zero or negative I_r permits redundancy/substitution.

Use validation click AUC for selection; report all four AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, parameters, allocated GPU seconds if supplied, train/wall time, examples processed, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 whole-batch latency. Missing telemetry remains unavailable, never estimated as measured.

Report predeclared host history-length slices empty, 1-16, 17-64 and >64 with sample/positive/negative counts. Empty-history differences after retraining can arise from global optimization, context updates and Dice state; they are not direct evidence of an event-level action path. Other slices are exploratory only if host provides them.
falsifiers: Reject the path interpretation before scoring if any original visibility restriction changes, forbidden current-label/target-action input is used, direct action coordinates leak into V=False summary/pool, or scorer action coordinates survive S=False.

Failure of bridge output/buffer/gradient parity or inherited parameter/initialization parity blocks comparisons to existing endpoints until corrected; any host diagnostics, failed attempt and rerun remain charged.

If scorer-only recovers more AUC than value-only, the direct-value dominance hypothesis fails. If A11-A01 is nonpositive, incremental scorer utility with values is unsupported. Do not discard either branch as a failed implementation without distinguishing execution from scientific outcome.

If I_task-I_shared is small or reverses under repetitions, the proposed routing dependence of path complementarity is unsupported. One fixed-seed numerical interaction is not significance or repeated mechanism evidence.

If future matched-capacity replacements or paired repetitions recover the token loss without true actions, the present information interpretation weakens. The existing brand-code control does not equalize frequency/optimization or establish production point-in-time validity.
alternative_explanations: Scorer interventions alter Dice population moments and training dynamics as well as conditional history weighting. Auxiliary paths and shared feature tables can change optimization globally even when their item/action gradients are stopped.

V=False keeps nominal capacity but deactivates some action-sensitive input columns and associated effective gradient routes. Equal stored parameters and shared bank execution do not establish equal effective capacity or equal compute.

S=False,V=True retains action information in pooled values and residual inputs; S=True,V=False can encode actions in weighted item features. Neither mixed cell, nor prior zero-token cells with action-derived masks, is feedback-free.
Residual shared averaging retains separate heads, task-dependent bases and gradient ownership. It changes sharing, gradient scaling and adapter coupling; it is not removal of all task conditioning.
Source and new runs have a common fixed seed but only one run per cell so far. Validation selection, seed noise, nonlinear AUC and inherited publisher whole-window assumptions limit attribution.

The context-code replacement at 0.6414296870 was almost null relative to token_zero_task at 0.6411900073. This disfavors that specific capacity replacement, not every capacity/optimization account. All six available trajectories succeeded; no execution-failure record is supplied and no unavailable campaign is imported.

The joint parent selects click AUC 0.6667535475 versus DIN 0.6555440824 while its all-task mean AUC is lower (0.7476025160 versus 0.8099233881). Thus click utility is not evidence of across-task improvement; all auxiliary regressions must remain visible. The supplied baseline and five topic/control receipts are all successful executions, while token-zero and brand-code branches are predictive counterevidence to their respective utility hypotheses.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read the card and pinned benchmark forward: action-derived multi_masks initialize sequence hubs. This reinforces that retaining masks leaves feedback information after token-channel interventions. Prior declared use was provenance only; prior local token-loss results neither validate INFNet nor a hub mechanism.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No INFNet mechanism adopted. The new intervention splits existing DIN scorer versus direct-value action coordinates, crossed with the inherited residual-bank readout.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No sequence/categorical/task hub aggregation or repeated broadcast. Source code inspected at pinned commit; original-paper equivalence and priority remain unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If implementation uses an action-derived grouping outside original permitted masks or cannot isolate the two action paths, the conditional interpretation fails; source provenance alone is not mechanism evidence.
